driver_pay_usd_sum.description: Total driver pay, app trips only.

fare_usd_sum.description: Total paid by riders before tips. For taxis, total minus tip.

service.description: uber, lyft, via, juno, yellow or green.

tips_usd_sum.description: Total tips. Taxi cash tips are not recorded.

trips_charged_cbd_fee.description: Trips that paid the congestion relief zone toll.

trips_with_wait.description: Trips with a known wait. Divide wait_minutes_sum by this.

wait_minutes_sum.description: Total rider wait, app trips only.

agg_trips_zone_hourly.description: Taxi and app trips per pickup zone per local hour, by service, since January 2024. Built from plausible trips only. Measures are sums and counts so they can be added across rows; for an average divide a sum by its count, for example wait_minutes_sum / trips_with_wait.

meta.grain: one row per service per zone per local hour

first_seen_at.description: First time the station appeared in the live feed after capture began.

has_charging.description: True where e-bikes charge while docked.

is_new_jersey.description: True for Jersey City and Hoboken stations.

region.description: NYC District, Bronx, JC District or Hoboken District.

station_id.description: Station id used by the live station status.

station_name.description: Station name, usually two cross streets.

station_number.description: Station number, for example 5506.14. Trips use this as start_station_number and end_station_number.

taxi_zone_id.description: TLC taxi zone, for comparing bikes with taxi and app trips.

dim_bike_station.description: Citi Bike stations, including those in Jersey City and Hoboken.

boro_code.description: Borough code: 1 Manhattan, 2 Bronx, 3 Brooklyn, 4 Queens, 5 Staten Island.

community_district.description: Borough code times 100 plus the district number. 305 is Brooklyn Community District 5.

district_name.description: Readable name, for example Brooklyn Community District 5.

is_joint_interest_area.description: True for parks and airports outside the numbered districts.

dim_community_district.description: Community districts, the 59 local areas each with a community board, plus joint interest areas for large parks and airports. 311 and many city reports are organized by these.

holiday_name.description: Name of the holiday, when there is one.

is_holiday.description: True on observed US federal holidays.

is_workday.description: True on weekdays that are not federal holidays.

month_start.description: First day of the month. Handy for grouping by month.

week_start.description: Monday of the week the date falls in.

dim_date.description: One row per calendar day from 2024 through 2027, with weekday, weekend and federal holiday flags.

cdta_code.description: Community District Tabulation Area containing the NTA.

cdta_name.description: Name of that area, which includes the community district it matches.

nta_code.description: NTA code, for example BK0101. Facts that carry a location have this column.

nta_kind.description: residential, park, cemetery, airport, special_use or jail.

nta_name.description: Neighborhood name, for example Greenpoint or Midtown-Times Square.

dim_neighborhood.description: Neighborhoods, as the city's 2020 Neighborhood Tabulation Areas (NTAs). 262 areas that nest inside community districts and boroughs. Use nta_name to match a neighborhood a person names, and nta_kind to leave out parks, cemeteries and airports when comparing rates.

complex_name.description: Names of the stations in the complex.

daytime_routes.description: All daytime routes serving the complex.

is_accessible.description: True when any station in the complex is accessible.

dim_subway_complex.description: Station complexes, the unit ridership is counted by. A complex is one station or several joined ones.

is_shuttle.description: True for the 42 St (GS), Franklin Av (FS) and Rockaway Park (H) shuttles.

route_color.description: Hex color of the route bullet.

route_description.description: Where and when the route runs.

route_id.description: Route id as riders know it: A, C, E, 1, 7, L, GS, FS, H, SI and so on.

route_long_name.description: Line name, for example 8 Avenue Express.

route_short_name.description: Name shown on the route bullet.

route_sort_order.description: Order the MTA lists routes in.

dim_subway_route.description: Subway routes in the current schedule, such as the A, the 7 or the 42 St Shuttle (GS).

accessibility.description: ADA accessibility: none, full or partial.

community_district.description: Community district the station is in.

complex_id.description: Station complex. Joins to dim_subway_complex and to ridership.

council_district.description: Council district the station is in.

daytime_routes.description: Routes that stop here during the day, as a list.

daytime_routes_text.description: The same routes as text, for example 'N W'. Use with LIKE or contains().

division.description: Historical division: IRT, BMT or IND.

in_congestion_zone.description: True inside the Manhattan congestion relief zone.

is_accessible.description: True when the station is fully or partly accessible.

line.description: Line the station is on, for example Astoria or Lexington Av.

north_direction_label.description: Where northbound trains are signed to.

police_precinct.description: Police precinct the station is in.

south_direction_label.description: Where southbound trains are signed to.

station_id.description: Station id in the schedule, for example R01. Platform ids add N or S.

station_name.description: Station name, for example Times Sq-42 St.

structure.description: Subway, Elevated, At Grade, Open Cut, Embankment or Viaduct.

dim_subway_station.description: Subway stations from the MTA station list. Arrival facts use station_id. Stations joined by passageways share a complex_id, and ridership is counted per complex.

borough.description: Borough. EWR for Newark Airport; empty for the placeholder zones 264 and 265.

centroid_nta_code.description: Neighborhood at the zone's center. Zones and neighborhoods do not line up exactly.

is_airport.description: True for JFK, LaGuardia and Newark.

is_yellow_zone.description: True inside the Yellow Zone, roughly Manhattan below 96th Street and the airports.

service_zone.description: Yellow Zone (where yellow cabs take street hails), Boro Zone, Airports or EWR.

zone_name.description: Zone name, for example JFK Airport or Upper East Side South.

dim_taxi_zone.description: TLC taxi zones, the 263 areas taxi and app trips are recorded by, plus two placeholder ids. Trip facts use pickup_zone_id and dropoff_zone_id, which join to zone_id here.

community_district.description: Community district at the middle of the link.

latitude.description: Latitude of the middle of the link.

link_name.description: DOT description: road, direction and end points, for example BQE N ATLANTIC AVE - BKN BRIDGE MANHATTAN.

longitude.description: Longitude of the middle of the link.

nta_code.description: Neighborhood at the middle of the link.

taxi_zone_id.description: Taxi zone at the middle of the link.

dim_traffic_link.description: Road links with DOT speed sensors, mostly highways and major arterials.

bikes_disabled.description: Broken or reserved bikes in docks.

ebikes_available.description: Electric bikes ready to rent, included in bikes_available.

is_empty.description: No bikes to rent while renting.

is_full.description: No docks free while accepting returns.

reported_at.description: When the station reported. Filter time ranges on this column.

fct_bike_station_status.description: Bikes and docks at each Citi Bike station, one row each time they changed, since capture began in October 2026. A row holds until the next row for the same station.

meta.grain: one row per station per change

is_round_trip.description: Returned to the station it started from.

start_station_number.description: Station number at the start. Joins to dim_bike_station.station_number.

started_at.description: Start instant. Filter time ranges on this column.

straight_line_miles.description: Distance between start and end as the crow flies. Not the route ridden.

fct_bike_trip.description: Citi Bike rides since January 2024, one row per ride.

borough.description: Borough, from NYPD or from the coordinates.

contributing_factor_2.description: Contributing factor for the second vehicle.

crashed_at.description: Crash instant. Filter time ranges on this column.

involves_cyclist_harm.description: A cyclist was hurt or killed.

involves_pedestrian_harm.description: A pedestrian was hurt or killed.

primary_factor.description: Contributing factor for the first vehicle, for example 'Driver Inattention/Distraction'. 'Unspecified' is common.

fct_collision.description: Motor vehicle crashes reported by NYPD since January 2024, one row per crash, with people hurt and killed by road user type. NYPD publishes with a delay of up to a few months.

age.description: Age in years. Empty when unknown.

contributing_factor.description: Contributing factor recorded for this person.

ejection.description: Whether the person was thrown from the vehicle.

injury_type.description: Type of injury, for example Complaint of Pain, Fracture.

person_type.description: pedestrian, bicyclist, occupant or other motorized.

role.description: Driver, Passenger, Pedestrian, Registrant and so on.

safety_equipment.description: Belt, helmet or other equipment recorded.

fct_collision_person.description: People involved in reported crashes, hurt or not, one row per person.

meta.grain: one row per person per crash

base_fare_usd.description: Fare before tolls, fees, taxes and tip.

cbd_congestion_fee_usd.description: Congestion relief zone toll passed to the rider. Charged from 5 January 2025.

company.description: Uber, Lyft, Via or Juno. Almost all trips are Uber or Lyft.

congestion_surcharge_usd.description: State congestion surcharge for trips through Manhattan below 96th Street.

driver_pay_usd.description: What the driver was paid, before tips.

file_month.description: Month of the TLC file. Filtering on it also skips files.

is_plausible.description: False for trips with impossible times, distances or fares. Exclude those from averages.

pickup_at.description: Pickup instant. Filter time ranges on this column.

pickup_hour.description: Pickup hour in New York, 0 to 23.

requested_at_local.description: When the rider asked for the ride, New York time.

rider_paid_usd.description: Everything the rider paid except the tip: fare, tolls, taxes and fees.

wait_minutes.description: Minutes from request to pickup: how long the rider waited. Empty when the request time is missing.

wav_matched.description: Trip was in a wheelchair accessible vehicle.

wav_requested.description: Rider asked for a wheelchair accessible vehicle.

fct_rideshare_trip.description: Trips by Uber, Lyft and the other app-based for-hire companies, one row per trip, from TLC monthly files since January 2024 (about 20 million a month). Includes what the rider paid, tips, what the driver was paid and how long the rider waited.

agency.description: Agency acronym, for example NYPD, DSNY (Sanitation), HPD (Housing), DOT.

channel.description: How it was filed: online, phone, mobile, unknown or other.

community_district.description: Community district the location falls in.

complaint_type.description: Top level problem, for example 'Noise - Residential', 'HEAT/HOT WATER', 'Illegal Parking'. Capitalization varies by agency.

council_district.description: Council district the location falls in.

created_at.description: Instant the request was filed. Filter time ranges on this column.

created_at_local.description: When the request was filed, New York time.

descriptor.description: Detail under the complaint type, for example 'Loud Music/Party' or 'Banging/Pounding'.

descriptor_2.description: Third level of detail, when used.

hours_to_close.description: Hours from filing to closing. Empty while open.

location_type.description: Kind of place, for example Residential Building/House, Street/Sidewalk.

modzcta.description: ZIP area the location falls in.

police_precinct.description: Police precinct the location falls in.

resolution_description.description: Last action reported by the agency.

status.description: Open, In Progress, Assigned, Pending, Started or Closed.

taxi_zone_id.description: Taxi zone the location falls in.

fct_service_request.description: 311 service requests since January 2024, one row per request in its latest state. Complaints about noise, heat, parking, streets and more, with the agency that handled them.

active_periods.type: STRUCT(starts_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, ends_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)[]

alert_type.description: MTA category, for example Delays, Planned - Part Suspended, Station Notice.

created_at.description: When the MTA created the alert.

first_active_at.description: Start of the first active period.

header_text.description: Headline. Routes appear in brackets, like [E].

last_active_at.description: End of the last active period. Empty means open ended.

route_ids.description: Routes named in the alert, as a list. Use list_contains(route_ids, 'E').

stop_ids.description: Stations named in the alert, as a list.

fct_subway_alert.description: Subway service alerts as the MTA published them, since capture began.

arrival_source.description: vehicle_stopped (train reported standing at the stop, more exact) or last_prediction.

arrived_at.description: Arrival instant. Filter time ranges on this column.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds late against the schedule. Negative means early. Empty for unscheduled trains.

direction.description: N (uptown and toward the Bronx) or S (downtown and toward Brooklyn).

feed_version.description: Schedule version used for the match.

is_scheduled_trip.description: True when the train matched a trip in the regular schedule.

service_date.description: Service day the trip belongs to.

stop_sequence.description: Position of the stop in the scheduled trip.

trip_uid.description: Train trip, service date plus trip id.

fct_subway_arrival.description: Observed subway arrivals since capture began in October 2026, one row per train per stop, matched to the schedule. delay_seconds is positive when late. About a quarter of trains are not in the regular schedule (added or rerouted trains), so they have no delay.

meta.grain: one row per train arrival at a stop

complex_name.description: Complex name with routes, for example 'Times Sq-42 St (N,Q,R,W,S,1,2,3,7)'.

fare_class.description: Fare category, for example full fare, students, reduced fare.

hour_start.description: Start of the hour as an instant. Filter time ranges on this column.

transfers.description: Entries that were free transfers, included in riders.

fct_subway_ridership_hourly.description: Estimated subway entries per station complex per hour since January 2024, split by payment method and fare class. Sum riders across rows for totals.

meta.grain: one row per hour per complex per payment method per fare class

outcome.description: arrived, skipped (dropped from the trip, often a reroute) or unreached (trip ended first).

predictions_seen.description: Polls that carried a prediction for the stop.

recorded_at.description: When the tracker wrote the row.

fct_subway_stop_event.description: Every stop outcome the train tracker recorded, including skipped stops and stops never reached.

meta.grain: one row per train per stop

first_seen_at.description: First poll that saw the trip.

scheduled_start.description: Scheduled departure from the first stop, HH:MM:SS.

stops_tracked.description: All stops the tracker followed for the trip.

stops_unreached.description: Stops still ahead when it left the feed.

fct_subway_trip.description: Train trips the tracker followed from start to finish.

cbd_congestion_fee_usd.description: Congestion relief zone toll. Charged from 5 January 2025.

is_plausible.description: False for trips with impossible times, distances or totals.

is_street_hail.description: Green taxis only. True for street hails, false for dispatched trips.

payment_type.description: credit card, cash, no charge, dispute, flex fare, unknown or voided.

pickup_at.description: Pickup instant. Filter time ranges on this column.

rate_type.description: standard, JFK flat fare, Newark, Nassau or Westchester, negotiated, group ride or unknown.

tip_usd.description: Tip. Only card tips are recorded, so cash trips show no tip.

fct_taxi_trip.description: Yellow and green taxi trips, one row per trip, from TLC monthly files since January 2024.

is_valid.description: True for normal readings. Use only these for speed averages.

observed_at.description: Reading instant. Filter time ranges on this column.

speed_mph.description: Average speed over the link, miles per hour.

status_code.description: DOT status code. 0 is a normal reading.

fct_traffic_speed.description: Speed readings on DOT sensor links, about one per link every five minutes, since January 2024.

meta.grain: one row per link per reading

alert_level.description: warning, watch, advisory or statement. Warnings are the most serious.

ends_at.description: When it ended or was cancelled.

event_key.description: Id of the event across zones.

event_name.description: Alert name, for example Heat Advisory, Flash Flood Warning, Winter Storm Watch.

hazard_code.description: Weather Service hazard code, for example HT heat, FF flash flood, WS winter storm, CF coastal flood.

last_action.description: Latest action seen live. Empty for archived alerts.

fct_weather_alert.description: Weather Service watches, warnings, advisories and statements for NYC, one row per event per forecast zone.

meta.grain: one row per alert event per zone

condition.description: clear, cloudy, fog, drizzle, rain, snow, thunderstorm or other.

feels_like_f.description: Feels-like temperature in Fahrenheit, with wind chill and humidity.

hour_at_local.description: Start of the hour in New York.

hour_hour.description: Hour of day in New York, 0 to 23.

hour_start.description: Start of the hour as an instant.

is_day.description: Sun up at the start of the hour.

is_forecast.description: True for hours that had not happened when the values were fetched.

is_heavy_precipitation_hour.description: At least 7.6 mm (0.3 in) in the hour, the Weather Service threshold for heavy rain.

is_snow_hour.description: Any new snow in the hour.

is_wet_hour.description: At least 0.1 mm of precipitation in the hour: it rained or snowed.

rain_mm.description: Liquid rain in the hour, millimetres.

snowfall_cm.description: New snow in the hour, centimetres.

snowfall_in.description: New snow in the hour, inches.

values_from.description: archive (settled) or model (recent days and forecast).

wind_direction_deg.description: Direction the wind comes from, degrees.

wind_speed_mph.description: Mean wind speed, miles per hour.

fct_weather_hourly.description: Hourly weather for one point in each borough since January 2024, from Open-Meteo. Settled archive values for history and model values for the last few days and the next day.

meta.grain: one row per borough per hour

feed.description: Feed within the source, when the gap affected just one.

ops_feed_gap.description: Periods a live feed was not captured, or was captured with less precision.

coverage_end.description: Latest event time in the table.

coverage_start.description: Earliest event time in the table.

freshness_sla.description: How old the last successful load may be before the table counts as stale.

hours_since_latest_event.description: Hours between the latest event in the table and now.

is_stale.description: True when the last success is older than the SLA.

last_error.description: Error of the latest run, if it failed.

last_loaded_at.description: When a load last wrote to the table.

last_success_at.description: When the source last finished a run successfully.

ops_source_freshness.description: How current each lake table is. Refreshed every 15 minutes.

holiday_date.description: Day the holiday is observed. Weekend holidays move to the nearest weekday.

us_federal_holidays.description: US federal holidays, on the day they are observed, 2024 to 2027.
